maddeler.e:
استرضوا (form X)
# اِسْتَرْضَوْا (istarḍaw) /is.tar.dˤaw/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَرْضَى (istarḍā)
# اُسْتُرْضُوا (usturḍū) /us.tur.dˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَرْضَى (istarḍā)
# اِسْتَرْضُوا (istarḍū) /is.tar.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَرْضَى (istarḍā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
